{
  "map": true,
  "subject": {
    "columns": ["protein_id"],
    "resolver": "pharos_protein_gene",
    "category": "biolink:Gene"
  },
  "object": {
    "columns": ["mondoid", "did"],
    "resolver": "curie",
    "category": "biolink:Disease",
    "name_column": "name"
  },
  "predicate": "biolink:gene_associated_with_condition",
  "association_category": "biolink:GeneToDiseaseAssociation",
  "knowledge_level": "knowledge_assertion",
  "agent_type": "manual_agent",
  "primary_knowledge_source": "infores:ctd",
  "qualifiers": {},
  "edge_properties": ["evidence"],
  "keep_if": null,
  "split_by": null,
  "by_value": {},
  "notes": "Each row links a Pharos protein (mapped to its gene) to a disease from CTD gene-disease curation. Disease identifier uses mondoid first, then did (DOID or MESH, both compact CURIEs); the name column labels the disease. The predicate is the generic gene-condition association because CTD does not state a direction or causal type. Evidence is kept as an edge property: 'marker/mechanism' rows reflect a gene marker or mechanism, while 'therapeutic' rows reflect a gene as a treatment target, which is a weaker and different claim. All rows are kept, so a reader can filter by evidence. Rows with no mondoid still map through did. The dataset is manually curated by CTD, so the agent is manual_agent."
}
